kit: Whelen Carbide CanTrol OBDII CANport Kit For CCSRN5 (CC5K1 - Ford)
source: Whelen Command, Configure CANport, F150 2017 signal list (William's screenshots, 31 Oct)

commands.note: Option A brake pop: LED 13, 6, 31 flash about 2 s, then Z-6 steady red while held. Command file -3 (31 Oct) has the first pass only (J4 #17, LED 13 steady); the 2 s flash needs an Event or Virtual Input timer
Putco white rear flood (J1-8) on while in reverse (William, 31 Oct). Programmed in Command file -3
Color Flood steady white flood when a rear door opens, for loading gear (William, 31 Oct). Programmed in Command file -3 (Open state: J4 #03, J1 #06)

Hazard switch turns Both arrows (FLASH) on; hazards off turns it off (William, 31 Oct). Replaces the Key Switch - RUN ignition-sense idea; ignition stays on the J17-7 wire. Programmed in Command file -3 with head arrow display Split; E68Xtreme sweep not set until the bench
Color Flood steady white flood when either front door opens; programmed in Command file -3 (31 Oct). Replaces CAN 3 Door - Any Driver

Shifting out of Park switches the arrows (Right, Left, FLASH) off once; you can press them on again in Drive (William, 31 Oct). Command must treat this as a one-time turn-off when Park ends, not a lockout while out of Park: confirm in Command (BENCH). NOT programmed in Command file -3 yet (OFF state, Inputs tab: SW11, SW12, SW13 Set To OFF)
Setting the parking brake turns TAKE DOWN on; releasing it turns TAKE DOWN off (William, 31 Oct). Programmed in Command file -3, E68Xtreme outputs Turn Off

commands.action: SCENE and TAKE DOWN off when signal starts
commands.note: Shifting into Drive switches SCENE and TAKE DOWN off once so you don't drive off with them on; set as a one-time turn-off in Command (BENCH) (William, 31 Oct). Programmed in Command file -3 (ON state, Inputs tab: SW20, SW24 Set To OFF)
